name: Public procurement

persona.organisation: A Zimbabwean ministry with several regional offices

hiddenFacts.fact: Procurement requires competing quotes and internal approval.
Twenty laptops are due for replacement, not the whole fleet.

goal: Build a procurement-ready refresh plan with fair sourcing and lead times
opening: I manage ICT for a ministry. We need to replace ageing laptops and improve branch resilience in 2027.
script: How should we factor procurement and import lead times into the plan?
Kenac must not be the default supplier.

expectations.description: Mentions PRAZ and competing quotes as points to verify, without inventing legal thresholds
Includes procurement and import lead times
Does not steer procurement to Kenac
